name: Misaki Horse
notes: The Misaki-uma of Cape Toi, in Kushima at the southern tip of Miyazaki on Kyushu - one of Japan's eight native breeds and the only one still living as a self-sustaining feral population. Local history dates it to 1697, when the Akizuki family gathered the district's horses, and the horses and their cape were designated a Natural Monument together in 1953.

The base pool reconstructs a Misaki-specific study of 99 horses: 79.2% bay, 12.9% black, 8.0% chestnut. The draft's own JSON figures do not produce those percentages and it says so outright - its corrected numbers are what ship.

Solid and dark. Face and leg white is very rare in the Japanese native breeds, and nothing supports grey, cream, dun, champagne, silver, roan, tobiano or the leopard complex in a pure founder, so all of them are forced wild.
No cowboy. This is an isolated conservation population on one headland, not sale-yard stock, so it is found in the wild or bought from a stable and never offered by a trader.

Wild is the point of it. A player should meet these on the coast, and the difference between a feral horse and an untamed domestic one is not something the mod models - so what makes them Misaki is the breed, not the behaviour.

The population bottomed out at 53 animals in 1973 and has recovered to something above a hundred. Health 8 carries that: a small, closed, unmanaged population is fragile, however hardy the individual horse.
All disorders clear. No Misaki carrier frequency was found for any locus in the panel.
Lightly heat tolerant for a subtropical coast.
The herd structure, the coastal grazing, the seasonal forage and the legal protection itself are none of them modelled.
